newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey confirms barley export, may sell more.
newsitem.headline: Turkey confirms barley export, may sell more.

text.p: Turkey's grain authorities on Monday confirmed a weekend sale of 125,000 tonnes of barley for export and said they may soon ship more.
Turkey awarded the barley at $136.07 per tonne to international trader Glencore, Mehmet Kutlu, deputy general manager of the Turkish Grain Board, said.

"Depending on the prices we may hold another tender to export barley," he told Reuters on the sidelines of a grains conference. He gave no timing but said much depended on results of the current Saudi tender to import 1.7 million tonnes.
